episodes.synopsis: Our favorite butler and master are back with more tea and cakes, more cutlery-based warfare, and more evil to rout from the London underworld.

episodes.synopsis: After a letter from Queen Victoria, some breaking and entering, and a trip to Undertaker, Sebastian and Ciel go to the circus. The mission: find a large group of missing children. The obstacle: Sebastian loses it a little when he's around cats...

episodes.synopsis: The air is thick with trapezes, knives, and pointed jibes as Sebastian and Ciel audition for the circus. Then after the excitement dies down, they see an unexpected familiar face in the rehearsal tent...
episodes.title: His Butler, Hired

episodes.synopsis: Sebastian and Ciel have done undercover work before, but this particular job presents some unique challenges.

episodes.synopsis: Sebastian and Will may well be the most awkward duo in circus history, but Ciel currently has bigger problems.
episodes.title: His Butler, Taking Flight

episodes.synopsis: Sometimes Sebastian's revisions to a plan can be dangerous.

episodes.synopsis: Before they pay the baron a visit, Sebastian decides to take some advice from Soma.
